passages.text: 文档撤权或删除的事务一旦提交，搜索、下载、引用和回答必须立即拒绝访问。OpenSearch 与对象存储中的物理投影允许在六十秒内完成清理，但这段时间不是访问宽限期。
用户被禁用、角色被修改或密码被重置时，服务端递增 authzEpoch 并注销该用户的全部现有 Session；旧 Cookie 从下一次请求开始返回未认证。

Only child chunks participate in first-stage retrieval and reranking. After ranking, the service may attach a bounded parent window from the same document and revision, while the matched child remains the evidence and citation anchor.

If query embedding or vector search fails, retrieval continues with BM25 and uses the reranker when it is healthy. If reranking fails, the service returns RRF order; when both model channels fail, it falls back to BM25.
新索引 Generation 完成构建和校验后只进入 READY，必须由管理员显式发布才切换 Alias。系统至少保留最近两个 Generation，并保证回滚窗口不少于二十四小时。
单份文档的新 Revision 完成索引后，只更新 PostgreSQL 的 currentRevisionId，不切换全局 Alias。较旧的 INDEX 任务即使晚完成，也不能覆盖已经发布的新 Revision。
Policy OPS-271 requires the on-call engineer to acknowledge a priority-one incident within 15 minutes. The four-hour restoration objective is tracked separately from acknowledgement.
Aurora Vault retains encrypted operational backups for 35 days. A restore drill is performed once per quarter, and drill results are attached to the continuity review.
制度 FIN-2026-07 规定，普通员工国内出差的酒店报销上限为每晚 680 元人民币，超出部分需要由个人承担。
通过 NebulaPay 发起的单笔付款超过 5000 元时，需要部门负责人审批；超过 20000 元时还需要财务负责人复核。
Atlas Harbor stores primary content for Singapore tenants in the ap-southeast-1 region. Replicas used for normal service remain inside the same regional boundary.
After an approved tenant deletion request, online records become inaccessible immediately and backup copies are purged within 72 hours.

documents.title: API Security Notes / 接口安全说明

passages.text: 错误码 RAG-4032 表示请求携带的 ACL 版本已经过期。客户端应刷新当前授权上下文后重新发起请求，服务端不得使用旧权限快照继续返回正文。
自动化 API 使用有作用域、有效期且可撤销的 Service Account Token；数据库只保存 token hash，不保存或再次显示原始 token。

documents.title: 员工假期与远程办公办法

passages.text: 政策 HR-LV-09 为符合条件的员工提供二十个工作日的带薪育儿假，假期应在子女出生后十二个月内使用。
Lotus Desk 计划允许员工每周最多远程办公三天，具体日期由直属经理与团队共同确认。
Release rule REL-88 requires two validated index generations to remain available for at least 24 hours after an alias switch.
A canary may become the default only after paired evaluation shows no authorization leaks and no regression beyond the declared quality and latency tolerances.
规则 SUP-410 将 Orion Freight 列为高风险物流供应商，新合同签署前必须完成安全与财务双重尽调。
Blue Lantern 审计发现的问题必须在九十天内完成整改，逾期事项自动升级给采购负责人。
